parbuckle.definition:
n. A kind of purchase for hoisting or lowering a
   cylindrical burden, as a cask. The middle of a long rope is made fast
   aloft, and both parts are looped around the object, which rests in the
   loops, and rolls in them as the ends are hauled up or payed out.
n. A double sling made of a single rope, for slinging a
   cask, gun, etc.
v. t. To hoist or lower by means of a parbuckle.
